panels.title: Attacker origins
panels.description: Each marker is one source IP, sized by hit count. Lat/lng come from GeoIP enrichment on CRITICAL alerts (and any other alert that was manually enriched via `enrich_ip`).

targets.queryText: SELECT source_ip AS ip, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') AS REAL) AS latitude, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.longitude') AS REAL) AS longitude, json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY hits DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT source_ip AS ip, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') AS REAL) AS latitude, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.longitude') AS REAL) AS longitude, json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY hits DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 25
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 25

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) * (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)), 'unixepoch')) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) * (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)), 'unixepoch')) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
